#Zombie Sagashitemasu Anime Overview:

Set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead, the story follows a young girl named Aki and her close childhood companions as they venture beyond the boundaries of their sheltered settlement. Raised on tales of a bygone human civilization and the catastrophic epidemic that destroyed it, Aki decides to leave home to locate her absent father. What begins as an enthusiastic exploration of the ruined landscape quickly transforms into a dangerous struggle for existence against hordes of zombies. Armed with youthful optimism and a desire for discovery, the group navigates the hazards of the deserted urban ruins while searching for answers about the fate of their family and the world before them.

images.alt:
Vertex Force Anime Overview:

Akira shares a quiet household with his mother, the proprietor of a local cafe, and his older sister Haruka. Beneath their ordinary daily routine lies a concealed legacy passed down through their paternal line: an anomalous supernatural ability known as the Engine. While Haruka secretly possesses this latent aptitude, Akira remains entirely devoid of the trait, leaving him weighed down by persistent feelings of inadequacy. This domestic equilibrium is abruptly disrupted when a series of bizarre, unexplained phenomena begin to manifest globally, threatening societal stability and forcing the siblings into extraordinary circumstances.

Japanese Title: バーテックスフォース

Black Clover 2nd Season Anime Overview:

Set in a world where magic is everything, Asta is born without any magical ability in a kingdom where power dictates status. Alongside his rival Yuno, who possesses immense magical talent and a rare four-leaf grimoire, Asta trains relentlessly to overcome his disadvantage and achieve his lifelong ambition of becoming the Wizard King, the highest-ranking magical authority in the land. After receiving a mysterious grimoire containing rare anti-magic capabilities, Asta joins the Black Bulls, an eccentric squad of misfit magic knights known for their destructive tendencies. Together with his fellow knights, Asta embarks on various missions across the realm, facing formidable threats, uncovering dark political conspiracies, and constantly striving to prove his worth while competing against Yuno for the ultimate title.

Japanese Title: ブラッククローバー 第2期
